description: This file defines the PostModal React component used for displaying a post with its comments, including real-time subscription to comment changes via Supabase. It handles data fetching, real-time updates, and user interactions for adding comments.

methods.name: PostModal({ postId, onClose })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a modal with a post and real-time comments, using React hooks for state and side effects.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Async function to insert a new comment into the 'comments' table in Supabase, associated with the current post and user.

calls: supabase.from('comments').select('id, content, created_at, user_id, profiles!inner(username)').eq('post_id', postId).order('created_at', { ascending: true })
supabase.from('comments').insert({ post_id: postId, content, user_id: user.id })
